usageNotes: Returns the directory index of available sub-resources and actions for a specific QEMU VM on a PDM-registered PVE remote. Use this as a discovery call to enumerate what child endpoints exist under a given VM before calling more specific operations (e.g., status, config, migration). The remote must be reachable and the vmid must exist on that remote; both are inherited path parameters with no server-side format enforcement, so invalid values return an error rather than an empty list.

examples.summary: List available sub-resources for VM 101 on the 'pve-hetzner' remote

tips: This endpoint is a directory index (returns null per the spec); its primary value is confirming that the remote+vmid path is valid and discoverable before chaining deeper calls.
Because permissions are set to 'user: all', any authenticated PDM user or API token can call this — no specific PVE privilege is required at the PDM layer.
API tokens (allowtoken: true) work here; prefer scoped tokens over user credentials in automation.
